Answer: C
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a well-defined, smooth opacity in the right paratracheal region that does not cause significant mass effect or invasion of surrounding structures, which is characteristic of a benign bronchogenic cyst. Other options describe locations (posterior, cardiophrenic, anterior) or features (irregular margins, calcifications) that do not match the image or the typical presentation of a bronchogenic cyst.
